name: Warding Maneuver
desc: When you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d8 and add it to the target's AC against that attack (you must be holding a melee weapon or a shield). If the attack still hits, the target has Resistance to its damage. Uses = your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), regained on a Long Rest.
